column1: # Game profile of Rocket League (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0). Bring-up in progress: see README.md beside this file and PROGRESS.md at the repository root
# Psyonix's game on Panic Button's Unreal Engine 3 port (package version 868, licensee 20) with Scaleform, PhysX 2 and Wwise, SDK 3.5.0, NVN. Modules main and sdk.
# The shaders are the global shader cache (globalshadercache-nnx.bin) and the caches inline in the cooked packages, whose chunks are Oodle (shader_split.py ue3_shaders).
# The packing script's guess from the survey, not measured yet: main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB, a 3,328 MB heap region; the NPDM declares no system resource
# The engine's system settings are held from the host for the player's Render scale and Dynamic resolution (dm/host/hle_ue3set.c; the table is found in main at run time)
